3d-castle-maze.name: 3D castle maze
3d-castle-maze.description: Find your way out of a 3D first-person perspective maze built out of 3D shape objects.

3d-platformer.name: 3D Platformer
3d-platformer.description: Walk, jump and reach the flag at the end of the level in a 3D environment.

3d-platforms.name: 3D platforms
3d-platforms.description: A simple platform movement example, but using 3D Shape objects for the platforms.

3dshape-tour.name: 3D shape
3dshape-tour.description: An interactive tour demonstrating what kinds of things can be done with the 3D shape object.

8-direction-behavior.name: 8 direction behavior
8-direction-behavior.description: A simple example of the 8-direction movement behavior, controlled with arrow keys. The player can also shoot bullets by clicking.

8-sided-billboard.name: 8-sided billboard
8-sided-billboard.description: A demonstration of an 8-sided billboard in a 3D environment with a retro aesthetic.

9-patch-plugin.name: 9-patch object
9-patch-plugin.description: Shows how to use the 9-patch object to draw images that only stretch the middle part.

abductractor.name: Abductractor
abductractor.description: Engage in an exciting tractor race with a catch: if you move while the scarecrow is watching, otherworldly anomalies will happen!

air-combat.name: Air combat
air-combat.description: A shoot-em-up where you must defend the frontier limits from the invaders with powerful missile barrages.

airborne-explorer.name: Airborne explorer
airborne-explorer.description: Propel your Mars rover off Martian forces to stay airborne, chain massive combos, upgrade your rover, and defeat the boss to bring vital intel back to Earth.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.description: Unravel all sorts of hidden materials by dragging and dropping to mix different materials.

alien-battle.name: Alien battle
alien-battle.description: Save the planet earth from the giant alien invaders, in a boss battle using timeline animations.

ancient-watcher-fortress.name: Ancient Watcher fortress
ancient-watcher-fortress.description: You find yourself in a forbidden place with a mighty entity inside. The only way out is to defeat it.

animated-spritefont-effects.name: Animated SpriteFont effects
animated-spritefont-effects.description: A demonstration of using events to modify BBCode over time, creating various animated SpriteFont text effects.

animated-svg.name: Animated SVG
animated-svg.description: A demonstration of using the HTML Element plugin to display an animated SVG.

animated-text-effects.name: Animated text effects
animated-text-effects.description: A demonstration of using events to modify BBCode over time, creating various animated text effects.

animated-title-screen.name: Animated title screen
animated-title-screen.description: Learn more about the timeline feature with an animated adventure game title screen.

arcade-shooter.name: Arcade shooter
arcade-shooter.description: Play an elite soldier invading the enemy base.

archery-range.name: Archery range
archery-range.description: Test your bow and arrow mastery in a 3D archery range.

artillery-war.name: Artillery war
artillery-war.description: Calculate the angle and power of your shots in order to destroy the enemy tower, in a two-player battle.

audio-analyser.name: Audio analyser
audio-analyser.description: Shows how to display a live graph of frequency information from the current audio playback.

audio-effects.name: Audio effects
audio-effects.description: A sound effect pad showing various effects that can be added to audio playback.

audio-player.name: Audio player
audio-player.description: An example of a simple media player with controls to seek, switch track, and adjust volume.

audio-positioning.name: Audio positioning
audio-positioning.description: An example of a layout with several positioned sound sources in it, where the audio pan and volume adjusts depending on the listener location.

audio-scheduling.name: Audio scheduling
audio-scheduling.description: Schedule sound playback at a sample-accurate time using the 'Schedule next play' action.

audio-scripting.name: Audio scripting
audio-scripting.description: Demonstrates using code to load and play sounds and music, using both the Web Audio API and an <audio> element.

audio-worklets.name: Audio worklets
audio-worklets.description: Demonstrates how to write custom audio processing code in JavaScript using audio worklets.

auto-maze.name: Auto maze 3D
auto-maze.description: Demonstrates an automated agent exploring a procedurally-generated 3D maze, in the style of a screensaver.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.description: Over a millennium since the last event, the mysterious avalanche has returned, along with evil creatures seeking to corrupt the tundra. It's your mission to restore the peace.

back-face-culling.name: Back face culling
back-face-culling.description: A visualization of the effect of back face culling on the 3D shape object.

balloon-blower.name: Balloon blower
balloon-blower.description: Use the power of your voice to make the balloon inflate and ascend, dodging threats and collecting cotton candy along the way.

bamboo-strike.name: Bamboo strike
bamboo-strike.description: Combine your raw strength and timing skills to cut through a massive line of bamboo in one strike.

basic-hierarchy.name: Basic hierarchy
basic-hierarchy.description: Demonstrates how the 'Add child' action can be used to connect objects, so they move and rotate together.

battery-sprint.name: Battery sprint
battery-sprint.description: This 3D platform runner challenges you to lead a little battery to the end of the level.

bbc-micro-bit-controller.name: BBC micro:bit controller
bbc-micro-bit-controller.description: A demonstration of using the BBC micro:bit as a controller for a game.

bbc-micro-bit-plugin.name: BBC micro:bit plugin
bbc-micro-bit-plugin.description: A demonstration of getting readings and updating the LED display of a BBC micro:bit device over Bluetooth using the special BBC micro:bit plugin.

bbc-micro-bit-raw.name: BBC micro:bit raw communication
bbc-micro-bit-raw.description: A demonstration of low-level access of the BBC micro:bit using the Bluetooth and Binary Data objects rather than the BBC micro:bit plugin.

bbcode-tag-range.name: BBcode tag ranges
bbcode-tag-range.description: Demonstrates how to use BBcode to tag ranges of text, e.g. to detect the mouse cursor over part of the text.

bboxperf.name: Bounding box performance
bboxperf.description: A performance test to measure how fast the CPU can calculate geometry for rotating sprites.

berry-harvester.name: Berry harvester
berry-harvester.description: Collect berries while navigating through obstacles, ensuring your harvesters remain intact to meet the daily quota.

bewitched-torches.name: Bewitched torches
bewitched-torches.description: Trapped in a haunted house, a little witch must ignite every torch to break free! But beware: shadowy bats lurk in the darkness, ready to catch you!

blackball-billiard.name: Blackball billiards
blackball-billiard.description: Prove yourself as the pool champion by challenging your friends to a local match of blackball billiards.

blacksmith-forge.name: Blacksmith forge
blacksmith-forge.description: Watch as the blacksmith expertly uses his hammering skills to craft a powerful blade.

blend-modes.name: Blend modes
blend-modes.description: Shows what effect each blend mode setting has.

block-breaking.name: Block breaking
block-breaking.description: A platformer where the player can set off a chain reaction that destroys blocks.

bluetooth-device-name.name: Bluetooth - device name
bluetooth-device-name.description: Uses the Bluetooth object to connect to a nearby device and read its device name.

bouncing-balls.name: Bouncing balls
bouncing-balls.description: Uses the Bullet behavior to create a bouncing ball movement.

bouncing-bullets.name: Bouncing bullets
bouncing-bullets.description: Shows how bullets can bounce off solids, creating a ricochet effect.

bouncy-ball.name: Bouncy ball
bouncy-ball.description: Move a bouncy ball in an isometric world and try to keep on the platforms.

bowling.name: Bowling
bowling.description: Display your bowling expertise and rule the lanes, stacking up impressive strikes in this classic bowling experience.

box-breaker.name: Box Breaker
box-breaker.description: Take command of a group of cowboys running in the Wild West, dodging and smashing incoming boxes!

boxing-club.name: Boxing club
boxing-club.description: Challenge your friends to a classic local multiplayer boxing match!

bucket-warrior.name: Bucket warrior
bucket-warrior.description: With a bucket in hand and courage in his heart, the kingdom's warrior is on a mission to extinguish the flames and defeat the dragon. Guide him to victory!

bullet-stepping.name: Bullet stepping
bullet-stepping.description: Shows how to improve collision accuracy with fast-moving bullets using the stepping feature.

bumble-beep.name: Bumble Beep
bumble-beep.description: Defeat the mighty Bumble Beep bot, the security enforcer for an alien world - a boss animated with timelines and hierarchies.

camera-average-color.name: Camera average color
camera-average-color.description: Using code to retrieve a video feed from the camera, get the video pixel data, and then calculate the average RGB value.

camera-effects.name: Camera effects
camera-effects.description: A demo of applying effects to the camera input from the User Media object.

camera-input.name: Camera input
camera-input.description: A simple example of accessing the user's camera using the User Media object, with options to take pictures or recordings and download the result.

cannon-launch.name: Cannon launch
cannon-launch.description: A platform game where you can also launch yourself from powerful cannons.

car-customization.name: Car Customization
car-customization.description: Fine tune your car to reach peak performance and rule the racing tracks.

car-selection-screen.name: Car selection screen
car-selection-screen.description: An example of a stylish car selection screen for a racing game, with car stats and more.

catch-the-rats.name: Catch the rats
catch-the-rats.description: Compete with a friend to see who can catch the largest number of rats in the sewers using giant cages.

catch-up-time.name: Catch-up time
catch-up-time.description: Demonstrates how to simulate time passing while the app was in the background by catching up on resume.

cave-bridge.name: Cave bridge
cave-bridge.description: Enter and explore the depths of a magical cave, using timeline animations to assemble a bridge.

ceiling-trap.name: Ceiling trap
ceiling-trap.description: A platformer template showing ceiling traps the player must escape by moving quickly past them.

cell-linking.name: Cell linking
cell-linking.description: Find and connect matching pairs of cells without intersecting lines or leaving the magnifying glass area.

cellf-defense.name: Cellf Defense
cellf-defense.description: Challenge friends in a multiplayer microscopic arena! Absorb smaller cells to grow, grab powerups for an edge, and dodge viruses in chaotic Petri dish battles.

cgs-auth-providers.name: Log in with providers
cgs-auth-providers.description: Demonstrates Construct Game Services authentication providers to allow users to log in.

cgs-cloud-save.name: Cloud save
cgs-cloud-save.description: Demonstrates Construct Game Services cloud save, allowing cross-device savegames based on an account login.

cgs-leaderboards.name: Online leaderboards
cgs-leaderboards.description: Demonstrates Construct Game Services leaderboards to provide online cross-platform hi-scores.

channel-striker.name: Channel Striker
channel-striker.description: The channel is under attack by enemy forces. Use your jet, powered by JavaScript code, to fight back!

charge-shot.name: Charge shot
charge-shot.description: A platformer where the player can hold down a button to charge up a more powerful shot.

chess-board-designer.name: Chess board designer
chess-board-designer.description: Translate between Forsyth-Edwards Notation (FEN) and board positions to save your game of chess for later.

chess-checkmate.name: Checkmate puzzle
chess-checkmate.description: Compete against the king to perform a checkmate, following the classic set of chess rules with flowchart logic.

child-particles.name: Child particles
child-particles.description: Demonstrates using a hierarchy to move an entire particle effect with an emitter.

classic-raycaster.name: Classic raycaster
classic-raycaster.description: Guide yourself through a maze using a simplistic visualization method.

clear-pipes.name: Clear pipes
clear-pipes.description: Move around a platform level by navigating a system of transparent pipes.

code-panel.name: Code panel
code-panel.description: Demonstrates a number panel where the player must enter the correct code, with some themed effects.

collect-the-pages.name: Collect the pages
collect-the-pages.description: Take a walk around the unsettling woods and collect all the pages, but be careful, there is something eerie lurking around.

collision-methods.name: Collision methods
collision-methods.description: Some re-usable sample collision handling methods, involving moving an object until it no longer overlaps something else.

combining-2d-3d.name: Combining 2D & 3D layers
combining-2d-3d.description: Demonstrates how setting a layer to 2D allows it to display top of 3D content regardless of depth.

command-and-construct.name: Command & Construct multiplayer RTS
command-and-construct.description: Follow the open development of a multiplayer real-time strategy (RTS) game using TypeScript coding in Construct.

compression.name: Compression
compression.description: Demonstrates how data compression works with the Binary Data object.

concussive-blast.name: Concussive blast
concussive-blast.description: A platformer template where the player must propel themselves by dropping and detonating bombs.

connect-four.name: Connect four
connect-four.description: Compete with another player to see who's able to place a four discs in a line first.

console-typist.name: Console typist
console-typist.description: In a mouseless era, quick typing was vital for efficient navigation. Test your speed by quickly entering words displayed on the console screen.

construct-animate-splash.name: Construct Animate splash
construct-animate-splash.description: Combines SVGs to have adaptive-scale graphics, with advanced use of blending modes to create timeline-animated dynamic masking.

coral-savior.name: Coral savior
coral-savior.description: Dive deep into the ocean to spread magical seeds in order to restore bleached corals, using audio effects for underwater sounds.

crafting-example.name: Crafting example
crafting-example.description: With the available raw materials, use the recipe book to create various items, all with the ultimate goal of crafting a quiver.

custom-action-overrides.name: Custom action overrides
custom-action-overrides.description: Demonstrates how a family custom action can be overridden by a member of the family.

custom-actions.name: Custom actions
custom-actions.description: A simple demonstration of the Custom Actions feature.

custom-canvas-drawing.name: Custom canvas drawing
custom-canvas-drawing.description: Demonstrates using a custom canvas element with HTML layers to draw an antialiased bezier curve with a rainbow gradient.

custom-layer-drawing.name: Custom layer drawing
custom-layer-drawing.description: How to use code to draw custom content to a layer, including drawing meshes directly from data arrays.

custom-movement-asteroids.name: Custom movement ('Asteroids' style)
custom-movement-asteroids.description: An 'Asteroids' type movement using the Custom Movement behavior.

custom-visual-novel-engine.name: Custom visual novel engine
custom-visual-novel-engine.description: In this visual novel based on a custom array-based engine, invent the perfect RPG to impress the leaders of the poetry or robotics club in order to secure a spot in one of them.

dash-slash.name: Dash Slash
dash-slash.description: A platformer where you can cut through floating orbs while avoiding dangerous traps on the way.

date-time.name: Date & time
date-time.description: An example showing some of the features of the Date plugin, which can manipulate various aspects of dates and times.

day-night-timelapse.name: Day-night timelapse
day-night-timelapse.description: Experience a beautiful time-lapse animation of Rio de Janeiro's vibrant landscape, set against the iconic backdrop of Christ the Redeemer.

demonoire.description: There are many riches to be had in the dungeon of the demon. Are you up to the challenge?

detecting-input-method.name: Detecting input method
detecting-input-method.description: How to create a title screen that automatically detects whether keyboard/mouse or touch controls are in use, and switches controls accordingly.

dig-the-way.name: Dig the way
dig-the-way.description: Dig through piles of dirt and help the miner find the gold nugget.

digiautos.name: Digiautos
digiautos.description: Battle in a futuristic championship where cars duel in a glowing arena, leaving neon trails of light behind.

disintegration-effect.name: Disintegration effect
disintegration-effect.description: An advanced effect demonstrating a player disintegrating as they teleport to a new location.

dock-fishing.name: Dock fishing
dock-fishing.description: Challenge a friend to see who can catch the most fish, while avoiding the lurking sharks.

drag-on.name: DragOn
drag-on.description: Drag your dragon to dodge bombs and collect pickups to grow longer.

draw-mesh-data.name: Draw mesh data
draw-mesh-data.description: An example of using the drawMeshData() API to more efficiently handle large meshes.

draw-the-line.name: Draw the line
draw-the-line.description: Draw lines to guide the ball past obstacles.

drawingcanvas-generate-image.name: Drawing Canvas: generate image
drawingcanvas-generate-image.description: Using code to generate an ImageData with custom pixel data, and then display it in a Drawing Canvas object.

dungeon-crawler.name: Dungeon crawler
dungeon-crawler.description: Move through a dark dungeon choosing your moves wisely so you don't run out of energy before reaching the end.

dynamic-camera-system.name: Dynamic camera system
dynamic-camera-system.description: Shows how to use some scrolling effects while moving between zones, as the adventurer finds the lost key.

echarts-demo.name: ECharts demo
echarts-demo.description: Demonstrates using JavaScript coding with the Apache ECharts library to display charts.

effects-glass.name: Effects: Glass
effects-glass.description: A simple demo of effects using a glass effect on a sprite.

effects-luminance-transition.name: Effects: Luminance transition
effects-luminance-transition.description: A transition effect based on altering luminance over time.

effects-oldtv.name: Effects: Old TV
effects-oldtv.description: Using multiple effects to create an old TV appearance.

effects-pixellate-transition.name: Effects: Pixellate transition
effects-pixellate-transition.description: A transition based on altering a pixellation effect over time.

effects-ripple-transition.name: Effects: Ripple transition
effects-ripple-transition.description: A transition based on altering a ripple effect over time.

effects-screen-blend.name: Effects: Screen blend
effects-screen-blend.description: An example of a use for advanced blending effects.

effects-swirl-transition.name: Effects: Swirl transition
effects-swirl-transition.description: A transition based on altering a swirl effect over time.

effects-water-transition.name: Effects: Water transition
effects-water-transition.description: A transition based on altering a water effect over time.

egg-catcher.name: Egg catcher
egg-catcher.description: Use your trusty skimmer to quickly pick the falling eggs before they hit the ground and break.

elemental-conveyors.name: Elemental conveyors
elemental-conveyors.description: Position elemental conveyors to deliver packages. Blocks react uniquely to elements, adding complexity to your task.

encryption.name: Encryption
encryption.description: Demonstrates using the Cryptography plugin to encrypt some text.

eventide.name: Eventide
eventide.description: Survive waves of spooky enemies and upgrade your character with new skills to progress!

exfiltration.name: Exfiltration
exfiltration.description: Use your radar to exfiltrate from the enemy base without being detected.

falling-blocks.name: Falling blocks
falling-blocks.description: An advanced example using recursive functions to determine which blocks are connected to the ground, and making those which are not to fall down.

families.name: Families
families.description: A simple example demonstrating how the 'Families' feature can be used to avoid repeating events.

family-tree.name: Family tree
family-tree.description: Read the clues carefully and place each person in the correct spot in order to rebuild the family tree.

farming-lines.name: Farming lines
farming-lines.description: Find a way to fill the land with seeds to make your farm grow larger.

fetch-local-file.name: Fetching project files
fetch-local-file.description: Shows how to fetch and display the contents of a project file using code.

file-system-text-editor.name: Text editor
file-system-text-editor.description: A simple demonstration of using the File System plugin to read and write text files.

fillrateperf.name: Fill rate performance
fillrateperf.description: A performance test to measure the GPU fill rate (how many large sprites can be rendered).

fire-bars.name: Fire bars
fire-bars.description: Shows how to create a rotating bar of flames as an obstacle for a platform game.

fireworks.name: Fireworks
fireworks.description: An animated bonfire and firework effect demo using lots of particles.

fireworks-designer.name: Fireworks designer
fireworks-designer.description: Design your own fireworks with custom patterns, and light up the sky in a stylish way.

first-person-platformer.name: First-person platformer
first-person-platformer.description: Demonstrates a simple 3D platformer style game with a first-person view, based on augmenting Construct's 2D collisions with events to also handle the Z axis.

flatland-golf.name: Flatland golf
flatland-golf.description: Calculate the correct amount of strength, taking the wind into consideration, to make the ball reach the hole.

floating-orbs.name: Floating orbs
floating-orbs.description: Travel around a platform level by jumping in to floating red orbs.

flowchart-questionnaire.name: Flowcharts questionnaire
flowchart-questionnaire.description: Demonstrates how to use the Flowcharts feature for a short questionnaire, with subsequent questions depending on previous answers.

flowcharts-and-containers.name: Flowcharts and containers
flowcharts-and-containers.description: Demonstrates how to use the Flowcharts feature with containers to manage multiple instances of the same flowchart.

foggy-outbreak.name: Foggy outbreak
foggy-outbreak.description: Explore a foggy and creepy alley filled with zombies in 3D.

follow-behavior.name: Follow behavior
follow-behavior.description: A simple demonstration of using the Follow behavior to follow an object.

follow-custom-properties.name: Follow custom properties
follow-custom-properties.description: Demonstrates how to use the Follow behavior to follow a custom property, like an effect parameter.

follow-path.name: Follow path
follow-path.description: Demonstrates making another object follow the player by storing a short history of positions in an array.

follow-record-replay.name: Follow record/replay
follow-record-replay.description: Demonstrates using the Follow behavior to record the player's movements and then replay the same movements.

follow-rewind-time.name: Follow rewind time
follow-rewind-time.description: Demonstrates using the Follow behavior to allow the player to rewind time and then continue from an earlier point.

free-the-key.name: Free the Key
free-the-key.description: You found the treasure in the ruins, but to get it, you must unlock its case by solving a sliding puzzle to insert the key into the keyhole.

fruit-merger.name: Fruit merger
fruit-merger.description: Combine smaller fruits into bigger ones, but without filling the entire screen.

fruit-slicing.name: Fruit Slicing
fruit-slicing.description: Be the main attraction of the restaurant by stylishly slicing fruits, but beware: someone is sabotaging the show by dropping bombs into the mix.

fuji-leaper.name: Fuji Leaper
fuji-leaper.description: Unleash your samurai skills to rid the swamp near Mount Fuji of pesky flies.

function-maps.name: Function maps
function-maps.description: Demonstrates how to use function maps to call a function by a string.

galactic-blocks.name: Galactic blocks
galactic-blocks.description: Protect your planet by matching and destroying colored meteors before they get too close.

gallery-swipe-gesture.name: Gallery swipe gesture
gallery-swipe-gesture.description: Shows how to detect a swipe gesture that is used to scroll along a gallery of images.

game-of-life.name: Game of life
game-of-life.description: Watch while civilizations rise and fall in a small cellular automaton world.

gamepad-control.name: Gamepad control
gamepad-control.description: A simple demo of how to use the Gamepad object as an alternative input to control a game.

gamepad-local-multiplayer.name: Gamepad local multiplayer
gamepad-local-multiplayer.description: Demonstrates how to use multiple gamepads connected to the same system for local multiplayer controls.

gemstone-forger.name: Gemstone Forger
gemstone-forger.description: Combine gemstones of the same type to forge increasingly rare and valuable gems. Your ultimate goal is to obtain the Infinite Gemstone.

generator-function.name: Generator function
generator-function.description: An example of using a generator function in code to only iterate certain instances.

geolocation.name: Geolocation
geolocation.description: A simple example of how to use the Geolocation object and show the resulting position on Google Maps.

ghost-chaser.name: Ghost chaser
ghost-chaser.description: Locate and capture ghosts in a haunted mansion using positioned sounds to guide you.

ghost-racer.name: Ghost racer
ghost-racer.description: A neon 3D racer where you can race against a ghost of your own best time.

ghost-shooter-rain-demo.name: The 'Rain demo'
ghost-shooter-rain-demo.description: A top-down shooter game making heavy use of visual effects.

gift-guesser.name: Gift guesser
gift-guesser.description: Find where each wrapped gift is by carefully looking at their distinct shapes.

glokar.description: Captain Glorktar and his cronies have stolen blueprints to the ultimate war machine. Track him down and take them out before it's too late!

gold-mining.name: Gold mining
gold-mining.description: Throw the hook at the right time and help the miner extract as much gold as possible.

graphing-calculator.name: Graphing calculator
graphing-calculator.description: Combines JavaScript code evaluation with mesh distortion to produce custom 3D graphs.

gravitational-field.name: Gravitational field
gravitational-field.description: Use the gravitational fields of planets to guide projectiles to targets.

gravity-portal.name: Gravity portal
gravity-portal.description: A platformer where you must help the little monkey reach the banana at the end of the level, using portals to invert gravity.

ground-shift.name: Ground shift
ground-shift.description: Shift between two completely different 3D worlds, in order to solve platforming puzzles.

grukkle-onslaught.name: Grukkle Onslaught
grukkle-onslaught.description: Defend your planets against the Grukkle invasion by building towers and expanding your civilization.

guess-the-number-js.name: Guess the number
guess-the-number-js.description: A simple guess-the-number game implemented with code.

guided-platforms.name: Guided platforms
guided-platforms.description: Demonstrates moving platforms that can also be controlled by the player.

gun-boots.name: Gun boots
gun-boots.description: Try out the dual purpose gun boots to fine tune your jumps and destroy the hazards below you.

hamburger-chef.name: Hamburger chef
hamburger-chef.description: Customers are craving your burgers! Grill each patty to perfection and assemble the correct combination of ingredients to fulfill every order.

hanoi-tower.name: Hanoi tower
hanoi-tower.description: A 3D example of the classic puzzle involving rearrange the discs.

hashing.name: Hashing
hashing.description: Demonstrates using the Cryptography plugin to calculate a cryptographic hash function for some text or a file.

hatch-room-transition.name: Hatch room transition
hatch-room-transition.description: Walk between rooms with a dynamic and stylish transition.

hero-attributes.name: Hero attributes
hero-attributes.description: A dynamic selection screen for you to choose your hero and delve into their backstory, featuring a morphing spider chart made using mesh distortion.

hexagonal-movement.name: Hexagonal movement
